_comment: Programmatic SEO research fields. Fields with runId use an existing run; others are built by the backend (app/seo_fields.py) from pubmedQuery.

fields.name: Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)
fields.description: Brain-computer interfaces, neural interfaces, and direct brain communication systems

fields.name: Neural Modulation (tDCS/TMS)
fields.description: Non-invasive brain stimulation including tDCS, TMS, and other neuromodulation techniques

fields.name: CRISPR Gene Editing
fields.description: CRISPR-Cas9 and other gene editing technologies for therapeutic and research applications

fields.name: Cancer Immunotherapy
fields.description: Cancer immunotherapy including CAR-T, checkpoint inhibitors, and immune-based cancer treatments

fields.name: AI in Drug Discovery
fields.description: Artificial intelligence and machine learning applications in drug discovery and development

fields.name: Alzheimer's Disease
fields.description: Alzheimer's disease mechanisms, biomarkers, and therapeutics
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Alzheimer Disease"[MeSH] OR alzheimer*[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Parkinson's Disease
fields.description: Parkinson's disease biology, alpha-synuclein, and treatment research
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Parkinson Disease"[MeSH] OR parkinson*[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Single-Cell Sequencing
fields.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing and single-cell genomics
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Single-Cell Analysis"[MeSH] OR "single-cell RNA"[tiab] OR "single cell RNA"[tiab] OR scRNA-seq[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Spatial Transcriptomics
fields.description: Spatially resolved transcriptomics and tissue omics
fields.pubmedQuery: ("spatial transcriptomics"[tiab] OR "spatial transcriptomic"[tiab] OR "spatially resolved transcriptomics"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Organoid Research
fields.description: Organoids and 3D stem cell-derived tissue models
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Organoids"[MeSH] OR organoid*[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Stem Cell Research
fields.description: Stem cell biology, iPSCs, and stem cell therapies
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Stem Cells"[MeSH] OR "induced pluripotent stem cells"[tiab] OR iPSC*[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Gene Therapy
fields.description: Viral and non-viral gene therapy and AAV vectors
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Genetic Therapy"[MeSH] OR "gene therapy"[tiab] OR "AAV vector"[tiab] OR "adeno-associated virus"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: mRNA Vaccines & Therapeutics
fields.description: mRNA vaccines, mRNA therapeutics, and lipid nanoparticle delivery
fields.pubmedQuery: ("mRNA Vaccines"[MeSH] OR "mRNA vaccine"[tiab] OR "mRNA therapeutic"[tiab] OR "mRNA therapeutics"[tiab] OR ("lipid nanoparticle"[tiab] AND mRNA[tiab])) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Gut Microbiome
fields.description: Gut microbiota and its role in health and disease
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Gastrointestinal Microbiome"[MeSH] OR "gut microbiome"[tiab] OR "gut microbiota"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Antimicrobial Resistance

fields.pubmedQuery: ("Drug Resistance, Bacterial"[MeSH] OR "antimicrobial resistance"[tiab] OR "antibiotic resistance"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: CAR-T Cell Therapy
fields.description: Chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy for cancer and beyond
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Receptors, Chimeric Antigen"[MeSH] OR "CAR-T"[tiab] OR "CAR T cell"[tiab] OR "CAR T cells"[tiab] OR "chimeric antigen receptor"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Tumor Microenvironment
fields.description: Tumor microenvironment, stroma, and tumor immunology
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Tumor Microenvironment"[MeSH] OR "tumor microenvironment"[tiab] OR "tumour microenvironment"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Liquid Biopsy
fields.description: Liquid biopsy, circulating tumor DNA, and cell-free DNA diagnostics
fields.pubmedQuery: ("Liquid Biopsy"[MeSH] OR "liquid biopsy"[tiab] OR "circulating tumor DNA"[tiab] OR ctDNA[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: AI in Medical Imaging
fields.description: Deep learning and AI for radiology and medical image analysis
fields.pubmedQuery: (("Deep Learning"[MeSH] OR "deep learning"[tiab] OR "artificial intelligence"[tiab]) AND ("Diagnostic Imaging"[MeSH] OR radiology[tiab] OR "medical imaging"[tiab] OR "medical image"[tiab])) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Protein Design & Structure Prediction

fields.pubmedQuery: ("protein design"[tiab] OR "protein structure prediction"[tiab] OR AlphaFold*[tiab] OR "de novo designed"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Functional MRI (fMRI)
fields.description: Functional neuroimaging and brain connectivity research
fields.pubmedQuery: ("functional MRI"[tiab] OR "functional magnetic resonance imaging"[tiab] OR fMRI[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Epigenetics

fields.pubmedQuery: ("Epigenesis, Genetic"[MeSH] OR "DNA Methylation"[MeSH] OR epigenetic*[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Synthetic Biology

fields.pubmedQuery: ("Synthetic Biology"[MeSH] OR "synthetic biology"[tiab] OR "genetic circuit"[tiab] OR "genetic circuits"[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.name: Aging & Cellular Senescence

fields.pubmedQuery: ("Cellular Senescence"[MeSH] OR "cellular senescence"[tiab] OR senolytic*[tiab] OR geroscience[tiab]) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]

fields.pubmedQuery: ("Nanomedicine"[MeSH] OR nanomedicine[tiab] OR (nanoparticle*[tiab] AND "drug delivery"[tiab])) AND ("2023/01/01"[dp] : "3000"[dp]) AND hasabstract NOT review[pt]
